intro: Table flip kaomoji (also called table flip ASCII, table flip emoji, or rage quit ASCII) is the (╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻ gesture — a person hurling a table, written entirely in Unicode text. It's plain text, not an image, so it pastes cleanly into chats, comments, bios, and captions on any platform. Whatever you call it — table flip kaomoji, table flip ASCII, or flip table text — every piece below is free to copy and paste, plus the calmer ┬─┬ ノ( ゜-゜ノ) for putting the table back.
